ability.name: Moral Support
ability.description: Futaba can either heal or raise stats on party members during battle

ability.name: Mementos Scan
ability.description: Futaba has a chance to full map a floor of Mementos upon entering

ability.name: Position Hack
ability.description: Futaba has a chance to start a battle with a Hold Up

ability.name: Active Support
ability.description: Moral Support now has a chance to Charge a party member or restore SP

ability.name: Treasure Reboot
ability.description: Futaba has a chance to restore search objects in the Metaverse after battle

ability.name: Emergency Shift
ability.description: When 2 or more party members are KO'ed, Futaba has a chance to swap them in with backup members

ability.name: Final Guard
ability.description: Futaba has a chance to negate a fatal attack to any party member
